reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for tag parsing and extends the existing getBudgetableCategories query with the group note, but does not put the new exclusion inside that shared selection.

duplication.why: The isFixedGroupNote check is added separately in six places (copyPreviousMonth plus five loops that all already share getBudgetableCategories) instead of once in the selection helper.

placement.why: The tree keeps month-wide eligibility (hidden, group hidden, saved templates) in getBudgetableCategories, yet the #fixed exclusion is placed in each action's loop next to the income check.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, the queries feeding them and a test are touched (plus a harmless import reorder in the test).

maintainability.why: Any future change to the fixed-group rule, or a new month-wide action, must remember to repeat the per-loop check, while the other exclusions live in the shared query.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg filter #fixed groups in their own loops instead of inside the shared getBudgetableCategories selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated condition is the same call to isFixedGroupNote pasted into each loop, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The #fixed exclusion is applied at six call sites in server/budget/actions.ts (copyPreviousMonth and the five loops over getBudgetableCategories); only the tag test itself is shared via isFixedGroupNote.
